diagnostics_saved: The diagnostics archive was saved to the selected location. It contains no audio.
subtitle: Classify from text first, then decide whether to analyze the remaining audio.
fast_description: The fast stage reads names, paths, metadata and package context without decoding audio.
review_hint: Select several review items and assign a category; double-click to reveal in Finder.
needs_review: Needs review; audio analysis is optional
busy_body: Choose Stop first. The current file will finish safely before stopping.
start_body:
The app will recheck old records, recursively classify and rename clearly identifiable audio, and consolidate documentation. Unresolved audio stays in place. Existing editing projects may need relinking.

Undo Latest Batch can reverse this operation. Continue?
ai_body:
Only {count} unresolved items shown in the window will be analyzed. The first run can download up to 5 GB of model files. Audio is not uploaded.

Completed quick classifications are not analyzed again.
undo_body: Undo the latest batch. A path conflict stops the operation. Continue?
quality_body:
This is a separate optional stage. It decodes only lossless/lossy candidate pairs in the same folder with matching base names.

Strict duration and waveform matches are shown for review before quarantine. Continue?
attachments_summary: Consolidated {count} documentation, license or supporting files.
skipped_summary: Safely skipped {count} files already current for this rule version.
next_audio: You can finish now, or choose ② Analyze Remaining Audio.
stopped_body: Completed operations were saved. Quick classify can skip them next time; audio results are cached.
no_folder: The folder cannot be found. Check that the external drive is connected.
